sql:
SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN refund_cents ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS refund_amount_rate
  , CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN order_id END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS cancel_rate
  , CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND refund_cents > 0 THEN order_id END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN order_id END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS refund_order_rate
  , CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN gross_cents - paid_cents ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN gross_cents ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS discount_rate
FROM "data"."main"."order_facts" order_facts_src_10000
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
answer: 统计范围：2026年8月，青禾客户范围内，以CRM会员账户为统计单位；本次结果未按门店拆分，为整体汇总。结果：退款金额占比 9.88%，口径为退款金额/实付金额；取消率 7.99%，口径为取消订单数/创建订单数；退款订单率 14.95%，口径为退款订单数/支付订单数；优惠率 10.02%，口径为优惠金额/支付订单原价金额。四项均有数值结果，不存在分母为零导致的未定义；数据为合成测试数据，覆盖至2026-09-01。
